facts.fact: Telemarketing calls to a home are prohibited before 8 a.m. and after 9 p.m. under FCC rules.
facts.quote: Telemarketing calls to your home are prohibited before 8 a.m. and after 9 p.m., and telemarketers must comply immediately with any do-not-call request you make during a call.

facts.fact: The National Do Not Call Registry can be registered for free at donotcall.gov or by calling 1-888-382-1222 (TTY: 1-866-290-4236).
facts.quote: You can register your numbers for free at [donotcall.gov,](http://www.donotcall.gov/ "Do Not Call Registry Home Page") or by calling 1-888-382-1222 (TTY: 1-866-290-4236).

facts.fact: FCC rules require a caller to obtain prior written consent, including through electronic means or a telephone keypress, before making a prerecorded telemarketing call to a home or wireless number.
facts.quote: FCC rules require a caller to obtain your prior written consent – on paper or through electronic means, including website forms or a telephone keypress – before they make a prerecorded telemarketing call

facts.fact: Prerecorded telemarketing calls must provide an opt-out option at the start of the message.
facts.quote: Prerecorded telemarketing calls must provide an opt-out option at the start of the message.

facts.fact: FCC rules ban text messages sent to a mobile phone using an autodialer unless the recipient previously consented or the message is for emergency purposes.
facts.quote: FCC rules ban text messages sent to a mobile phone using an autodialer unless the phone owner previously gave consent to receive the message or the message is sent for emergency purposes.

facts.fact: Commercial texts require written consent, while informational texts may be consented to orally.
facts.quote: Commercial texts require written consent; for informational texts, your consent may be oral.

facts.fact: Most mobile carriers let consumers block spam by forwarding the message to 7726 (SPAM).
facts.quote: Most mobile carriers let you block spam by forwarding the message to 7726 (SPAM)—check with your provider.

facts.fact: Landline political robocalls are allowed without prior consent under the Telephone Consumer Protection Act.
facts.quote: Landlines: Political robocalls (autodialed or prerecorded) are allowed without prior consent.

facts.fact: AI-generated voice calls are illegal unless the consumer has agreed to receive them or the caller is exempt.
facts.quote: AI-generated voice calls are illegal unless the consumer has agreed to receive them or the caller is exempt.

facts.fact: FCC rules allow market research or polling calls and calls on behalf of tax-exempt non-profit groups to landline numbers.
facts.quote: FCC rules allow market research or polling calls and calls on behalf of tax-exempt non-profit groups to landline numbers.

facts.fact: The FCC has issued hundreds of millions of dollars in enforcement actions against illegal robocallers.
facts.quote: Issued hundreds of millions of dollars in enforcement actions against illegal robocallers.
